name: threecx-mcp
description: Run every client's 3CX phone system from one CLI: trunk, version, licence and backup health across the whole fleet, plus the full Configuration API on any single PBX.

threecx_client_id.title: THREECX_CLIENT_ID
threecx_client_id.description: Sets THREECX_CLIENT_ID for the 3CX MCP server. Get a credential from https://www.3cx.com/docs/configuration-rest-api/.

threecx_client_secret.title: THREECX_CLIENT_SECRET
threecx_client_secret.description: Sets THREECX_CLIENT_SECRET for the 3CX MCP server. Get a credential from https://www.3cx.com/docs/configuration-rest-api/.

threecx_fqdn.title: THREECX_FQDN
threecx_fqdn.description: Host name of the 3CX phone system (for example pbx.example.com), the {fqdn} in https://{fqdn}/xapi/v1.

threecx_base_url.title: 3CX API base URL
threecx_base_url.description: Optional. Full XAPI base URL. Leave blank: the CLI builds https://<THREECX_FQDN>/xapi/v1. Set it only to point at a different host or port.

threecx_token_url.title: OAuth2 token URL
threecx_token_url.description: Optional. Token endpoint the client-credentials exchange posts to. Leave blank: the CLI uses the phone system's own /connect/token. It must be on the same host as the API.

threecx_oauth_scope.title: OAuth2 scope
threecx_oauth_scope.description: Optional. Scope sent with the client-credentials exchange. Leave blank to send none.

threecx_fleet_dir.title: Fleet registry directory
threecx_fleet_dir.description: Optional. Absolute path of the directory holding the registry of client phone systems used by the fleet commands. Leave blank to use the CLI's config directory.

threecx_pbx.title: Phone system to use
threecx_pbx.description: Optional. Name of one phone system registered with fleet add; the server then uses that PBX's host, client ID and secret variable (the same as --pbx). Leave blank to use THREECX_FQDN and the credentials above.

threecx_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
threecx_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call.

threecx_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
threecx_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off.

threecx_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
threecx_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

threecx_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
threecx_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on 3CX requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.
